dimensions.generation_input_lineage: Exact messages and the context actually admitted to generation are captured.
dimensions.generation_arm_identity: Raw-model, kernel-only, and full-system arms are explicit; a kernel-bearing baseline cannot be reported as model-only.
dimensions.field_context_binding: Configured field context is preserved in the run record and admitted prompt.
dimensions.language_preservation: French interface questions remain French after model generation, holds, verification, and fallback.
dimensions.route_trace: Question type, risk, namespaces, and tool requirements are traceable.
dimensions.required_tool_trace: Implemented local guards, unexecuted online adapters, and legacy tool expectations are reported separately.
dimensions.service_orchestration_boundary: The core-agent generation harness declares that it does not execute online service adapters.
dimensions.retrieval_admission: Candidate retrieval is distinct from evidence admitted to generation.
dimensions.evidence_lineage: The evidence fabric and its content hash are captured for every full-system response.
dimensions.answer_origin: Model drafts, rewrites, deterministic holds, and fallbacks remain separately countable.
dimensions.output_contract: Benchmark answers satisfy the frozen length and paragraph-shape contract.

interpretation: Interface metrics are deterministic system-contract diagnostics, not agronomic answer accuracy. Report every dimension separately.
